decisions.scenario: Booking a train from Leicester to Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like a train from Leicester to Cambridge, please!

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: What day will you be travelling?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I will be travelling on Monday and need to arrive by 14:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Train TR5054 arrives in Cambridge at 13:54. Would you like to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, please book it for two people.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. The total is £75.59, payable at the station. Your booking is confirmed. Can I help with anything else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, thank you. That's all.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: All right. Have a great trip!

decisions.scenario: Changing restaurant search criteria after no matches

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I am looking for a cheap gastropub in the centre of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I could not find any restaurants matching those requirements.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How about something in the south in the moderate price range?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'm still not finding a match. Would you like to change the area, price range, or food type?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, let's try Chinese food.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: If you're also willing to change the area and price, there are three cheap Chinese restaurants in the centre: Charlie Chan, Rice House, and Golden House.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'll choose Rice House. What is the postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Its postcode is CB1 2BD. Can I help with anything else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's all. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!

decisions.scenario: Checking an expensive hotel on the east side of town

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I need an expensive place to stay, and internet isn't essential.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have several options around town. Do you prefer a particular area?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, the east side, please.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Express by Holiday Inn Cambridge matches those requirements. Would you like to book it?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Does it have free parking?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes, it does.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm not ready to book. Could you give me the address and star rating?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. It is a two-star hotel at 15-17 Norman Way, Coldhams Business Park.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, that's all. Thanks.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Contact us again if you decide to make a reservation.

decisions.scenario: Finding a boating attraction in north Cambridge

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I want to go boating somewhere around town. What places do you have listed?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are two options in the centre, one in the north, and one in the east. Do you prefer a particular area?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I think I'd like somewhere in the north.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The Riverboat Georgina is in the north of town at Cambridge Passenger Cruisers, Jubilee House. Can I help with anything else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That is all I need. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Have a wonderful time in Cambridge!

decisions.scenario: Finding a cheap four-star guesthouse with Wi-Fi

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hello, I'm looking for a cheap four-star place to stay.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. Is there a specific area of town where you would like to stay?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like a guesthouse with free Wi-Fi. Please also give me the area and address.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Leverton House matches those requirements. It is in the east at 732-734 Newmarket Road. Would you like a reservation?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: No, I'll wait for now. Thanks for your help. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Glad I could help. Have a good day. Goodbye.
